dct_description_sm: This data collection includes the Supporting Information for the paper: Streams with Riparian Forest Buffers versus Impoundments Differ in Discharge and DOM Characteristics for Pasture Catchments in Southern Amazonia. It contains measurements of precipitation, temperature, oxidation-reduction potential, discharge, baseflow, dissolved organic carbon (DOC), DOC components, slope ratio, and fluorescence indices (FI, HIX, BIX)
dct_title_s: Data for: Streams with Riparian Forest Buffers versus Impoundments Differ in Discharge and DOM Characteristics for Pasture Catchments in Southern Amazonia
